title: AC Installation in Selma, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can help with a quality AC replacement solution in your Selma home. Call us today to schedule an AC installation.

blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we want to take the stress out of any AC installation job in Selma, TX. It’s important to have a fully functional air conditioner in your home when summer arrives. If your current unit is more than 10 years old, it could be prone to breaking down. Older systems are less energy efficient than new ones and could end up costing you more money to run. When you’re ready to move forward with an AC replacement, our experienced team can help you choose the right AC unit. It’ll be properly sized for your home and meet any of your unique cooling needs. A new air conditioner can be considered a great investment in a property.

Our skilled air conditioning experts can take care of the details of any AC replacement project. They’ll remove your old unit from your home to ensure that its various parts are disposed of safely. High-quality parts will be used to install your new system so that it can operate flawlessly for a long time.
There are many benefits of getting a new air conditioner.

Technicians from Rosenberg Plumbing & Air are NATE certified and ready to make any job in Selma go smoothly. Our company is a member of the ACCA and has received the Residential Contractor of the Year Award. As a BBB-accredited business with an A+ rating, the complete satisfaction of our customers is placed as a top priority. Our company is fully licensed, bonded, and insured, and every job receives our full attention.

To make it easy to schedule with us, we offer flexible appointment availability. You can count on our technicians to arrive at their appointments punctually. They’ll be in company vehicles and wearing our team uniform. We’re based out of a shop on Vance Jackson Road in San Antonio, and we can install any make or model of air conditioner for you.
To learn more about getting a new air conditioner for your home in Selma, call our crew at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today.
Older heaters can also stop operating properly. Our technicians can help you choose a new heating installation that will work for your specific needs.
If your air conditioner isn’t working normally, we’re ready to take a look. After we find the cause of a problem, we can perform your AC repair efficiently and professionally.
Maintaining your air conditioner can keep it running reliably for a long time. Our goal is to optimize the efficiency of your unit so that you can save money.
